attack_techniques: Remote Services: Distributed Component Object Model (T1021.003)
attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to gain persistence or move laterally over the network by executing code on remote hosts using the DCOM RPC interface. The DCOM RPC interface is used to remotely invoke registered COM applications on remote hosts.
description: The endpoint performed abnormal DCOM RPC activity to a remote host.
investigative_actions: Review the action of the initiated COM application on the remote host. Correlate the RPC call from the source host and understand which software initiated it.* Verify that this isn't IT activity.
name: Rare DCOM RPC activity
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
